rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for Headings. They are banned.
Apply tight letter spacing on all headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Use massive weight contrast: make headings extra bold (font-black) and body text clean and readable.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase, Tiny (text-xs), and Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Max heading size: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl. DO NOT exceed text-6xl.

fallback_fonts.body: Inter (only if IBM Plex Sans is unavailable)

rules: Neo-Brutalist Contrast: Soft pastels must be paired with hard black borders (border-2 border-[#171717]) to avoid looking childish.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or generic grays for borders. Use deep charcoal (#171717).
Never use full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid flat or with subtle noise/grain.

shadows: BANNED: Soft, blurry, generic SaaS drop-shadows.
MANDATORY: Solid offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#171717]) for active cards, buttons, and focused inputs.
surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces for all dashboard cards.
Apply 2px solid dark borders to primary cards and inputs.
For modals/dialogs, use sharp corners or max 8px (rounded-md) border-radius to maintain the brutalist feel.
textures: Use subtle SVG noise overlays (opacity-30) to kill the digital flatness on the main dashboard background.

general: Cards: Flat, 2px solid border, sharp or slightly rounded corners (max 8px). Solid drop shadow on hover.
Buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. 2px solid border. Active/Hover state should translate slightly (e.g., translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px]) and reduce the solid shadow to simulate pressing.
Inputs: 2px solid border, pale pastel background on focus.
Sidebar: Distinct pastel background (e.g., pale mint or butter yellow) separated from the main content by a 2px solid border.
mcq_practice: Question Card: Massive, clear typography for the question.
Options (A/B/C/D): Large clickable zones. When selected, bold the text and change background to a distinct pastel. If correct, use Mint green. If wrong, use Coral red. Apply hard solid borders.
Explanation Box: Distinct pale background (e.g., Lavender or Yellow), appearing seamlessly below the question with a dashed or solid border.
progress_dashboard: Use strict grid hierarchy (dense and compact spacing).
Charts: Use Shadcn chart components / Recharts. Style them with the neo-brutalist solid pastel colors and hard borders.
Metric Cards (Summary): col-span-1, solid pastel backgrounds.

layouts.grid_strategy: The High Density Grid for Dashboards
rules: Dashboard Content: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) around main containers. Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding.
Sidebar should be sticky or fixed with full height (h-screen).
Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, MCQ options, nav links).
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (transition-transform, transition-colors).
When a user selects an MCQ answer, use a quick, satisfying scale or color-fill micro-animation.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="mcq-option-a"`).
Maintain high contrast ratios (APCA or WCAG AA minimum). Hard black text on pastels is naturally high contrast.
Never rely on color alone to indicate correct/incorrect (use icons + color).

image_urls.category: Empty states, auth screen background, or 'Upload Notes' placeholder
Hero or banner background for the 'Mixed MCQ' section

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default). For a punchier look, consider adding phosphor-icons if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (use Shadcn Dropdown, Dialog, Tabs).
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Note uploaded successfully', 'Progress saved').
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, sidebars, or dropdowns. They must be opaque.
Implement the UI with a strict Light Theme Neo-Brutalist aesthetic: soft pastel backgrounds (yellow, mint, lavender) with hard 2px solid deep charcoal (#171717) borders and sharp offset shadows.
Use Cabinet Grotesk (or Outfit) for headings and IBM Plex Sans (or Inter) for body text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through solid offset shadows rather than blurry generic shadows.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern, sharp interaction animations & colors relevant to the neo-brutalist style.
Use 2-3x more padding than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
